status.text: Rubin has been silent since 15 Nov (8 nights): weather or a technical stop. The sky floors show the last data night.

floors.headline: Explosions follow the dark matter: not yet
floors.detail: Lensing −0.2σ, clusters +0.9σ (324 seen, 295 expected). 3σ expected late 2027.

floors.headline: SN 2025agpz leads the night
floors.detail: Rare here: SLSN-II, swung 3.9 mag. 11 bright transients for a small telescope in the last 30 days.

floors.headline: 2026 JZ, near-Earth asteroid
floors.detail: A near-Earth asteroid, e 0.52; its orbit passes 0.022 AU from Earth’s, so it counts as potentially hazardous. 11 near-Earth asteroids among 2,401 tracked.

floors.headline: Quiet space weather: Kp 0.7
floors.detail: Solar wind 328 km/s, Bz −4.5 nT, south.

floors.headline: Aurora power 22 GW in the north
floors.detail: OVATION Prime: the chance of aurora overhead in the next 30 to 90 minutes, a model, not a sighting.

floors.headline: Storm over northern Argentina, 29,937 flashes an hour at its peak
floors.detail: 1.26 million flashes in the 24 hours to 18:00 UTC. No Lightning Imager data that night: Europe and Africa are missing.
